notes.title: Playtest Update v0.4.3
notes.notes:
New playtest update!

[h2]Changes Since v0.4.2[/h2]
[list]
[*]More sounds! More sounds!
[*]Textures! Wow!
	[*]The player character is now complete!
[*]Improved physics and character performance
[*]Rebalanced weapon pickups
	[*]You can now only pick up a new weapon if your hands are free.
	[*]You can still drag a new weapon onto your body, then use the number keys to swap it into your hand.
[*]Fixed players getting stuck in the ground and in walls (yay)
[*]Fixed kicking stuff into oblivion when you touch it
[*]Fixed W.I.L.S.O.N. trying to trip you at every opportunity
[*]Fixed a couple minor UI bugs
[*]Added "disable all UI" button (F6)
[*]Added recoil to railguns
[*]Added combat state tracking and new music
[/list]

[h2]Changes Since v0.4.1[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more sounds for various objects
[*] Added textures to more things
[*] Added new main menu screen
[*] Added rat enemies as the new first enemy the player fights
[*] Added a placeholder intro cutscene
[*] Improved flow of first couple quests
[*] Improved game UI
[/list]
